notes: Each cover you finish 25, halfway 15. Snake off the edge 500, an eraser 300, the tennis ball 100.
Round bonus 1,000 plus 250 a round, 50 a frisbee left. Extra life at 8,000, then every 14,000.

victories: ride a frisbee and lure the jump rope off the edge.
catch one of the chalkboard erasers.
finish all four rounds of a level.
readme: Q*Nerd: the arrow keys or WASD hop on the diagonals, turned like the cabinet's stick (up hops up-right, right down-right, down down-left, left up-left), P pauses.
claude: - Q*Nerd (owner 2026-10-26, locker order): authentic 1982 Q*bert rules and scoring (src/qbert, 17 rule checks), a nerd boy hops a pyramid of stacked school books on isometric dot paper, chased by basketballs and a jump rope snake, with chalkboard erasers, a stapler, a hole punch and frisbee discs; arrow keys follow the cabinet's turned stick; same amendment list.
